verdict: Ads paused since Aug 6 — leads are stopped, restart is in motion.
narrative: Meta ads went dark on August 6 and have run at zero spend for 17 consecutive days, which means all 38 leads and $884 in spend this period belong to the first 11 days of the window. The timing is particularly costly because the campaign was gaining momentum just before it paused — the final three active days produced 9 leads versus 5 in the three days prior. With paid activity stopped, your Google Business Profile engagement has also fallen sharply, dropping 67% week over week and hitting zero actions on the last three days reported. Ads are being reactivated, and SMS follow-up automation is being stood up by end of August to ensure every incoming lead is worked immediately once volume resumes.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all from the first 11 days before ads paused
cost per lead while ads were running — the campaign was efficient before going dark
consecutive days at zero ad spend, accounting for the full lead stoppage

watch_item.issue: Ads have been paused since August 6, bringing new leads to a complete halt and pulling organic profile traffic down with it.
watch_item.fix: Ads are being reactivated now, and automated SMS follow-up is going live by August 31 so the intake pipeline is ready to handle volume when leads resume.
